_doc: The 16-question Free Time Fortune exam. 'scale' answers are integers -2 (strongly disagree) to +2 (strongly agree) and multiply the 'd' weights. 'duel'/'pick' answers are the 0-based option index and add that option's 'd'. 'budget'/'time' answers are the 0-based option index and set the constraint to that option's 'v'. Identical to the web version, so both give the same ranking.
